description: Draw a Gantt chart (a project timeline): one bar per task from its start to its end date, optionally coloured by group or phase. Use for project plans, roadmaps and schedules. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

data.description: One row per task: {task, start, end, group?}; start and end are dates like '2026-03-01' (or numbers).

name: generate_gantt_chart
title: Gantt chart
